/**
 * Used by the developer tools (in the toolbox process) for opening URLs.
 * MDN URLs get send to a browser, all others are displayed in a new window.
 *
 * Thunderbird code should avoid using this function.
 *
 * This is similar, but not identical, to the same function in Firefox.
 *
 * @param {string} url - The URL to load.
 * @param {string} [where] - Ignored, only here for compatibility.
 * @param {object} [params] - Optional parameters for changing behaviour.

text: 1894 deletes openUILinkIn and its comment that the upstream add-on manager’s contribute button used it. The fixed mail-tree identifier query has no remaining reference. That local absence does not prove that upstream or dynamically loaded code has no caller. The accepted neighboring openWebLinkIn still documents its developer-tools owner and ignored compatibility parameter. Scoped review proposal: verify the external entry point and document retained compatibility parameters before deleting a shim. Bug and review context may explain the old comment; that explanation remains unread. No add-on contribution action was tested. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.
title: Check upstream callers before declaring a compatibility link shim unnecessary
